chapters.title: Welcome / About This Book
chapters.subtitle: A short opener before the story begins.

questions.prompt: What would you like the title of your book to be?
Who are you writing this for? (e.g. your children, grandchildren, a specific person)
Write a short dedication or opening message to the reader(s).
What do you hope they take away from reading your story?
Upload a current photo of yourself to open the book.
If you could only pass on one piece of advice from this whole book, what would it be? (We'll revisit this at the end too.)

chapters.title: Where It All Began
chapters.subtitle: Birth, family of origin, early roots.

questions.prompt: When and where were you born?
Tell the story of your name — why were you named that? Any nicknames growing up?
Tell me about your parents — who were they, what were they like?
What do you know about your grandparents or family heritage?
Where did your family come from, and how did you end up where you grew up?
Upload a baby photo or family photo from this time, if you have one.
What's a family story from before you were born that's been passed down to you?
Did you have siblings? What was the birth order and dynamic like?
What's your earliest memory?
Describe the house/home you grew up in.
What was your neighbourhood or town like back then?
Who was your best friend growing up, and what did you get up to together?
What were you like as a child — shy, loud, mischievous, dreamy?
Tell me about a teacher, relative, or other adult who had a big influence on you.
What's the most trouble you ever got into as a kid?
Upload a favourite childhood photo.
What did you want to be when you grew up?
What games, shows, or toys were you obsessed with?

chapters.title: The Teenage Years
chapters.subtitle: Identity, culture, first steps toward independence.

questions.prompt: What were you like as a teenager?
What music, fashion, or trends were "your" era?
Tell me about your first job, however small.
Did you play sports, music, or have a hobby you were passionate about?
What's a memory from school (good or bad) that's stuck with you?
Who were your closest friends, and are you still in touch with any of them?
Upload a photo from your teenage years.
What was a rule your parents had that you hated at the time?
What's something you were really proud of as a teenager?

chapters.title: Becoming an Adult
chapters.subtitle: Leaving home, early career, figuring life out.

questions.prompt: How and when did you leave home / become independent?
What did you do after school — college, work, travel, something else?
What was your first place of your own like?
What was the first "real" job you had, and what did it teach you?
What was a big decision you made in your 20s that shaped everything after?
Did you travel anywhere that changed your perspective?
Upload a photo from this chapter of life.
What do you wish someone had told you at this age?
What were you most afraid of back then — and how did that turn out?

chapters.title: Love Story
chapters.subtitle: Meeting a partner, dating, commitment. Skip or adapt freely if not applicable.

questions.prompt: How did you meet your partner?
What was your first impression of them?
Tell the story of your first date, or the moment you knew it was serious.
How did the proposal happen (if applicable)? Who proposed to whom?
Tell me about your wedding day, or how you chose to commit to each other.
Upload a photo of you two together — then or now.
What's something about your partner that still makes you laugh or smile?
What's the secret to making a relationship last, in your experience?
If this chapter doesn't apply to you, what relationships (family, friends) shaped this period instead?
How did you find out you were going to become a parent, and how did you feel?
Tell the story of the day your child (or each child) was born or arrived.
How did you choose your child's/children's name(s)?
What surprised you most about becoming a parent?
What's your favourite memory from their first year?
Upload a photo from the early days of parenthood.
What were you most scared of as a new parent?
Who or what helped you most in those early days?

chapters.title: Watching You Grow
chapters.subtitle: A chapter about the people who grew your family. Add one entry per person (children, grandchildren, etc).

questions.prompt: Describe their personality — what makes them, them?
What's a memory with them that you'll never forget?
What did/do they do when they were little that still makes you smile?
What's a challenge you faced together, and how did you get through it?
What do you most admire about them today?
Upload a favourite photo of you together.
What do you hope for their future?
Is there anything you've never told them that you want them to know?
What's a funny or embarrassing story about them they probably don't want in the book (but you're including anyway)?

chapters.title: Family Life & Traditions
chapters.subtitle: Everyday life, holidays, food, the texture of family.

questions.prompt: What family traditions matter most to you, and how did they start?
Share a family recipe and the story behind it.
What did a normal/ordinary day look like for your family?
What holidays were biggest in your house, and how did you celebrate?
Did you have any family pets? Tell me about them.
What's a phrase or saying that gets repeated in your family?
Upload a photo from a family tradition or celebration.
What's the funniest thing that's ever happened at a family gathering?
What do you hope your family keeps doing, even after you're gone?
What has been your main career or life's work?
What achievement are you most proud of, and why?
What was the hardest period of your working life, and how did you get through it?
Did you ever take a big risk professionally? What happened?
Who mentored or believed in you along the way?
Upload a photo connected to your work or an achievement.
What's something you accomplished that nobody really knows about?
If you could go back, would you choose the same path?
What's the most important lesson life has taught you?
What advice would you give your children about love, work, and life?
What's something you regret, and what did you learn from it?
What are you most grateful for?
What does happiness mean to you, at this stage of life?
What's a belief or value you hold that you hope gets passed down?
What's something you'd want your grandchildren (current or future) to know about you?
If you could relive one day of your life exactly as it happened, which would it be?
Write a closing letter to the reader(s) of this book.
Looking back at the advice you gave in Chapter 1, has anything changed now you've finished the book?
